history.summary: The plan is complete and parses: six phases (decision, JenkinsDeploy ServiceAccount, ArgoCDDeploy grants, hook destroy mode, pipeline and its job, runbook) and 19 criteria. One question is open (plan_questions_r1.md Q1): ArgoCDDeploy's grants reach prd only through a manual sync of argocd-prd (autoSync false), so the operator must rule on who syncs it before Ruling D3's test-phase dry runs can run.

Ruling D4 applied: V13 now carries the test phase's own argocd-prd sync through config-prd-write behind a diff check (argocd-prd is Synced at ArgoCDDeploy origin/main 9334541 today), with V08/V09/V13 owed to the operator if anything else differs. The plan's six phases and their citations re-verified this pass, and the dry-run parse is clean.

The plan is sound and complete against slice.md, but one design gap needs an operator ruling: the guard requires the stage to be pruned, and the prune removes the namespace and with it the Job identity's only grant on that namespace's objects. So any stage whose state holds namespaced Kubernetes objects (the postgres-db and s3-storage Secrets in seven deploy repos) fails to plan with 403, while FieldnotesDeploy dev, the only case tested, cannot show it. Two advisory points: parameters in config.xml vs the style guide, and a re-run once config/<stage>/ is gone.

Review r1 rulings applied. F1: P4 sets every namespaced Kubernetes object in the stage's state aside with no new grant, and its dry run writes nothing; P1 and P6 carry the accepted leftover; new V20 and updated V01/V03/V07/V08. A1: P5 creates the job from the style guide's config.xml, and the parameter-less registration build is the test phase's, after the pushes (V17, ordering constraints). A2: the destroy mode passes config/<stage>/ tfvars only when present (P4, V15). The dry-run parse is clean.
